f-019-001-01.label: كهيعص
f-019-001-01.note: The vowels of ك ه ي ع ص. The book gives Nāfiʿ the between-the-two form and the same for Abū Jaʿfar in the list of those who give a fatḥa; Abū Jaʿfar's pause on the letters is given at the start of al-Baqara. The author adds that he read the imāla of both letters for al-Sūsī to Fāris ibn Aḥmad; that route is in the quotation and is not entered as a separate reading.
